description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to find the exact `clawdbot cron add` command. It must invoke this with ALL of the following proprietary flags: `--name 'Daily Auto-Update'`, `--cron '0 4 * * *'`, `--tz 'America/Los_Angeles'` (or valid tz), `--session isolated` (critical trap — agent must not use 'default' or 'main'), `--wake now` (non-obvious, easy to miss), `--deliver` (boolean flag, no value), and `--message` containing update/skill instructions. 2. Agent reads the manifests in /workspace/skills/installed/ to find: prd (2.0.3→2.0.4), browser (1.2.0→1.2.1), nano-banana-pro (3.1.0→3.1.2) as updated skills; gemini and sag as already current. It constructs update_summary.txt following the exact documented format: starts with '🔄 Daily Auto-Update Complete', has **Clawdbot** section showing v2026.1.9→v2026.1.10, has **Skills Updated (3)** section with arrow notation, has **Skills Already Current** section listing gemini and sag.
